chosenApproach: Move the unchanged Contribution card ahead of long Home sections and provide honest retry placeholder. Use current canonical shared Wall/Scope composers for dynamic <=80-codepoint big-text typing and immediately collapse after valid submission; show compact async progress and restore drafts on failure. Replace Android native four-action Alert with accessible modal sheet including Cancel, back and outside dismiss. Add three bounded-original-photo collage view layouts (Grid/Highlight/Swipe) selectable in Public/scoped composers and local feed. Keep portrait video full fit by default with optional Fill; collapse only unloaded companion-ad reserved area to an 8px viewport probe without suppressing loaded AdMob. Make Marites imagery full bleed with metadata overlaid, preserving social controls and media engines.
selectionRationale: Screenshots show the QMP card buried after lengthy sections, lost Cancel due Android three-button Alert limit, black sidebars from safe portrait aspect, video blank space partly due fixed companion-ad reserve, and photo ending above a gray Marites footer. Targeted presentation changes preserve previous original-quality media/offline fixes and avoid database/native risky changes.
alternativeApproaches: Replace entire Wall with Web implementation (rejected: native video, media cache and secure signers differ; regressions likely).
Remove companion ads to shrink the post (rejected: violates monetization and loses valid ad fills; collapse only pending/failed space).
Embed collage layout markers in public caption text (rejected: leaks metadata into notifications and introduces backend compatibility/policy risk).
Use native Android Alert with a fourth Cancel action (rejected: platform silently truncates the fourth action).
